content.text:
I added the `external_links` extension in `markdown/extensions/external_links.py`. A tree processor registered at priority 15 sets `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on every `<a>` whose `href` starts with `http://` or `https://`. It needs no config, and I did not run the new tests (the tester writes them).

- **Other files:** I added the `pyproject.toml` entry point, the `mkdocs.yml` nav entries, and the new pages `docs/extensions/external_links.md` and `docs/reference/markdown.extensions.external_links.md`. I also added a row and link reference in `docs/extensions/index.md`, and an `### Added` changelog entry under Unreleased.
- **Checks:** `python -m unittest discover tests` passes (1166 tests, 111 skipped). flake8 is clean on the new file. `zensical build --strict` and `pyspelling` both pass, and I deleted `site/`.
- **Manual check:** inline links, `<https://…>` autolinks and linked images get the attributes; the image itself and `#anchor` and mailto autolinks stay unchanged. I tried this with the dotted path `markdown.extensions.external_links`, not the short name `external_links`. I did not check the short name, which needs the entry-point metadata regenerated by a reinstall.
- **Attribute order:** the serializer sorts attributes alphabetically, so `<a>` comes out as `href`, `rel`, `target`, not the order in the design's examples. Tests should check for attribute substrings, as the design suggests.

I added the `external_links` extension in `markdown/extensions/external_links.py`. A tree processor registered at priority 15 sets `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on every `<a>` whose `href` starts with `http://` or `https://`. It needs no config, and I did not run the new tests (the tester writes them).

- **Other files:** I added the `pyproject.toml` entry point, the `mkdocs.yml` nav entries, and the new pages `docs/extensions/external_links.md` and `docs/reference/markdown.extensions.external_links.md`. I also added a row and link reference in `docs/extensions/index.md`, and an `### Added` changelog entry under Unreleased.
- **Checks:** `python -m unittest discover tests` passes (1166 tests, 111 skipped). flake8 is clean on the new file. `zensical build --strict` and `pyspelling` both pass, and I deleted `site/`.
- **Manual check:** inline links, `<https://…>` autolinks and linked images get the attributes; the image itself and `#anchor` and mailto autolinks stay unchanged. I tried this with the dotted path `markdown.extensions.external_links`, not the short name `external_links`. I did not check the short name, which needs the entry-point metadata regenerated by a reinstall.
- **Attribute order:** the serializer sorts attributes alphabetically, so `<a>` comes out as `href`, `rel`, `target`, not the order in the design's examples. Tests should check for attribute substrings, as the design suggests.
